name: reading

tools.name: browse
tools.help: Look for books: give a query (a subject, title or author), or leave it out to wander the shelves and see what's there.

tools.name: read
tools.help: Settle in and read a book (by #id or title) for a while. You'll take in what you read when the time is up, and next time you pick up where you left off.

reason: Reading as a module: browse and read at the library, on the engine's books source (the owner's books, found and condensed by the engine); a reading session of real time, bookmarks in its store, and what was read told as a moment. Replaces the engine's own reading.
